summary: My content system: a Notion board from idea to posted, with Claude handling script review and stats.
body: My content system: a Notion board from idea to posted, with Claude handling script review and stats.

Every video is one card that moves: idea, scripting, filming, editing, scheduled, posted.
Claude does the boring parts: bulk script review, pulling my Metricool numbers into Notion, spotting which hooks perform.
Every post gets a score (Hit 700+, Solid 400-699, Low under 400). Build updates with the app on screen average about 700 views. Advice clips with no product: about 315.
Tools: Notion https://www.notion.so · Claude https://claude.ai · Metricool https://metricool.com
Comment NOTION and I'll share how my board is set up.
